errors.text_span: а най-ниската е около 17 000 през 2011 година
errors.evidence: The description states that the lowest value for water transport is in 2011, but the chart shows the lowest value is in 2012 (approx. 12,000). The value in 2011 is higher (approx. 18,000).

errors.text_span: докато през 2010, 2011 и 2012 година стойностите на сухоземния транспорт надвишават тези на водния транспорт
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect for the year 2010. In 2010, the value for water transport (approx. 26,000) is higher than the value for land transport (approx. 22,000). Land transport only exceeds water transport in 2011 and 2012.
